upstream.description: TenTix (10x Efficiency) - An AI native customer service platform with 10x accelerated resolution. Support MCP extension, and AI knowlage base system.

classification.analysis: Tentix is an open-source AI-native customer service and ticketing platform (TypeScript, Bun) that pairs a support-ticket system with a LangGraph AI agent doing RAG over a unified PostgreSQL+pgvector knowledge base (starred conversations, historical tickets, general docs), configurable handoff and MCP-style workflow nodes, and Feishu notifications. Aimed at teams wanting a self-hosted, AI-accelerated helpdesk with an admin knowledge-base UI and a visual React Flow workflow editor for the AI agent's behavior.

use_cases.title: Self-host an AI-assisted customer support ticketing system
Build a RAG knowledge base from historical support tickets
Design an agent handoff and escalation workflow visually
Route customer messages to a support agent via Feishu
